## 1. Two cure formulations

The package implements two cure formulations on the Exponentiated
Danish kernel: the mixture cure model and the promotion-time
(non-mixture) cure model.

## 2. Bone marrow transplant data

```{r}
library(BetaDanish)
data("transplant")
str(transplant)
```

## 3. Promotion-time cure model

```{r}
fit_prom <- fit_bd_cure(
  formula_aft  = survival::Surv(time, status) ~ 1,
  formula_cure = ~ group,
  data         = transplant,
  type         = "promotion",
  n_starts     = 3
)
summary(fit_prom)
```

## 4. Mixture cure model

```{r}
fit_mix <- fit_bd_cure(
  formula_aft  = survival::Surv(time, status) ~ 1,
  formula_cure = ~ group,
  data         = transplant,
  type         = "mixture",
  n_starts     = 3
)
summary(fit_mix)
```

## 5. Model comparison

```{r}
data.frame(
  Model  = c("Promotion-time", "Mixture"),
  logLik = c(fit_prom$logLik, fit_mix$logLik),
  AIC    = c(fit_prom$AIC,    fit_mix$AIC),
  BIC    = c(fit_prom$BIC,    fit_mix$BIC)
)
```

## 6. Cox-Snell residual diagnostic

```{r}
plot(fit_mix)
```
